capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: same hardware as MY2017 (the page read); model years compared 2017 to 2018, nothing shows a change. BMW US release: "overall battery energy to 33 kWh", 94 Ah.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: same hardware as MY2017 (the page read); model years compared 2017 to 2018, nothing shows a change. BMW US release: 27.2 kWh "can be effectively used".

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: same hardware as MY2017 (the page read); model years compared 2017 to 2018, nothing shows a change. BMW US 2017 release: BMW Home Charger Connect "can precondition the vehicle battery when connected" and the battery can be warmed before starting off (no navigation trigger or DC-charge trigger described). Read as manual/scheduled only; the 2019 page mentions cabin pre-conditioning and battery warming "under certain conditions". Owner may prefer none.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: same hardware as MY2017 (the page read); model years compared 2017 to 2018, nothing shows a change. BMW US release: "future-proof 50 kW direct current (DC) fast charging", standard equipment; under 40 min to 80 %.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: same hardware as MY2017 (the page read); model years compared 2017 to 2018, nothing shows a change. BMW US release: "The 7.4 kW charging electronics of the BMW i3 (94 Ah)".
